say:2:1826023001:1.text: Tres, I have a task for you.
say:2:1826023001:1.source_cn: 崔斯，有件事情需要交给你去办。
say:2:1826023001:1.male: Tres, I have a task for you.
say:2:1826023001:1.female: Tres, I have a task for you.

say:3:1826023002:1.text: Bantus has sent someone here to pry into Her Ladyship's condition.
say:3:1826023002:1.source_cn: 班题斯派来了一位不速之客，意图打探领主现下的情况。
say:3:1826023002:1.male: Bantus has sent someone here to pry into Her Ladyship's condition.
say:3:1826023002:1.female: Bantus has sent someone here to pry into Her Ladyship's condition.

say:4:1826023003:1.text: I need you to show him around the city to buy us more time.
say:4:1826023003:1.source_cn: 你需要带他在城内游览，并以此为借口，尽可能拖住他。
say:4:1826023003:1.male: I need you to show him around the city to buy us more time.
say:4:1826023003:1.female: I need you to show him around the city to buy us more time.

say:5:1826023004:1.text: 是，埃德加少爷。我需要拖延他多久？
say:5:1826023004:1.source_cn: 是，埃德加少爷。我需要拖延他多久？

say:6:1826023005:1.text: 在避免他察觉到异常的前提下，越久越好。
say:6:1826023005:1.source_cn: 在避免他察觉到异常的前提下，越久越好。

say:7:1826023006:1.text: 你受过隐士的训练，应当自有分寸。
say:7:1826023006:1.source_cn: 你受过隐士的训练，应当自有分寸。

say:9:1826023008:1.text: 梅林阁下，您是否还有其他需要交代崔斯的事？
say:9:1826023008:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您是否还有其他需要交代崔斯的事？

choice_prompt:10:1826023008.text: Magister Merlin, do you have any other instructions for Tres?
choice_prompt:10:1826023008.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您是否还有其他需要交代崔斯的事？
choice_prompt:10:1826023008.male: Magister Merlin, do you have any other instructions for Tres?
choice_prompt:10:1826023008.female: Magister Merlin, do you have any other instructions for Tres?

say:11:1826023009:1.text: 是。我会以道路损毁严重，需要维修为理由，劝他绕道而行。
say:11:1826023009:1.source_cn: 是。我会以道路损毁严重，需要维修为理由，劝他绕道而行。

choice:10:0:1.text: The Syndicate and the Repair House are off-limits.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 尽量别让他靠近黑金商会和修缮屋
choice:10:0:1.male: The Syndicate and the Repair House are off-limits.
choice:10:0:1.female: The Syndicate and the Repair House are off-limits.

say:12:1826023010:1.text: 是。班题斯的使者必定会问及与诺珐斯的各项合作，我会以领主阁下近日怠惰为借口。
say:12:1826023010:1.source_cn: 是。班题斯的使者必定会问及与诺珐斯的各项合作，我会以领...

say:13:1826023011:1.text: 若他坚持，我会带他前去检查。那些项目确实没有任何进展。
say:13:1826023011:1.source_cn: 若他坚持，我会带他前去检查。那些项目确实没有任何进展。

choice:10:1:2.text: Just blame everything on Tephesia's procrastination.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 可以多用苔佩希的拖延症当借口
choice:10:1:2.male: Just blame everything on Tephesia's procrastination.
choice:10:1:2.female: Just blame everything on Tephesia's procrastination.

choice:10:2:3.text: Watch everything he does. Don't miss a single detail!
choice:10:2:3.source_cn: 观察他都做了什么，不要遗漏细节！
choice:10:2:3.male: Watch everything he does. Don't miss a single detail!
choice:10:2:3.female: Watch everything he does. Don't miss a single detail!

say:17:1826023014:1.text: 梅林阁下，您是否好奇过，我们所处的这座城堡与庄园，究竟藏有多少秘密？
say:17:1826023014:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您是否好奇过，我们所处的这座城堡与庄园，究竟...

say:18:1826023015:1.text: 呵……一想到要将这些宝贵的情报和盘托出，真不免有些心痛。
say:18:1826023015:1.source_cn: 呵……一想到要将这些宝贵的情报和盘托出，真不免有些心痛。

choice_prompt:19:1826023015.text: Heh... Laying such precious intelligence bare does wound me a little.
choice_prompt:19:1826023015.source_cn: 呵……一想到要将这些宝贵的情报和盘托出，真不免有些心痛。
choice_prompt:19:1826023015.male: Heh... Laying such precious intelligence bare does wound me a little.
choice_prompt:19:1826023015.female: Heh... Laying such precious intelligence bare does wound me a little.

say:21:1826023018:1.text: 看来，这些情报的“货款”，只能留待母亲大人苏醒后再结清了。
say:21:1826023018:1.source_cn: 看来，这些情报的“货款”，只能留待母亲大人苏醒后再结清了。

choice_prompt:22:1826023018.text: Then this debt must wait until Mother wakes to be settled.
choice_prompt:22:1826023018.source_cn: 看来，这些情报的“货款”，只能留待母亲大人苏醒后再结清了。
choice_prompt:22:1826023018.male: Then this debt must wait until Mother wakes to be settled.
choice_prompt:22:1826023018.female: Then this debt must wait until Mother wakes to be settled.

say:23:1826023019:1.text: I'm not the ruler. Unless Mother entrusts me with her authority, my word won't carry as much weight as yours.
say:23:1826023019:1.source_cn: 我并非领主，想必母亲大人昏迷前也没有嘱咐仆人听从我的命...
say:23:1826023019:1.male: I'm not the ruler. Unless Mother entrusts me with her authority, my word won't carry as much weight as yours.
say:23:1826023019:1.female: I'm not the ruler. Unless Mother entrusts me with her authority, my word won't carry as much weight as yours.

say:24:1826023020:1.male: Then there's the risk of being recognized by one of the Novaris nobles. If any of them reported my whereabouts to Bantus... how do you suppose Bantus would respond?
say:24:1826023020:1.female: Then there's the risk of being recognized by one of the Novaris nobles. If any of them reported my whereabouts to Bantus... how do you suppose Bantus would respond?

choice_prompt:25:1826023020.source_cn: 此外，诺珐斯贵族中不乏认识我的亡灵。万一有人将我的行踪泄露给班题斯，您认为他们会作何反应？

choice_prompt:25:1826023020.female: Then there's the risk of being recognized by one of the Novaris nobles. If any of them reported my whereabouts to Bantus... how do you suppose Bantus would respond?

say:26:1826023021:1.text: With Mother unconscious, Novaris is left without a leader... To Bantus, this would be the <style="highlight">perfect time to invade</style>.
say:26:1826023021:1.source_cn: 庇护诺珐斯的领主伤重昏迷，群龙无首之际……<style...

say:26:1826023021:1.female: With Mother unconscious, Novaris is left without a leader... To Bantus, this would be the <style="highlight">perfect time to invade</style>.

choice_prompt:27:1826023021.female: With Mother unconscious, Novaris is left without a leader... To Bantus, this would be the <style="highlight">perfect time to invade</style>.

say:28:1826023022:1.text: We can, but only for so long.
say:28:1826023022:1.source_cn: 保得了一时，护不住一世。
say:28:1826023022:1.male: We can, but only for so long.
say:28:1826023022:1.female: We can, but only for so long.

say:29:1826023023:1.text: Anyway, we're short on time. <style="highlight">I'll tell you what I know about this castle first</style>.
say:29:1826023023:1.source_cn: 还是先允许我<style=highlight>向您介绍...
say:29:1826023023:1.male: Anyway, we're short on time. <style="highlight">I'll tell you what I know about this castle first</style>.
say:29:1826023023:1.female: Anyway, we're short on time. <style="highlight">I'll tell you what I know about this castle first</style>.

choice:27:0:1.text: The Solitaries can defend Novaris too.
choice:27:0:1.male: The Solitaries can defend Novaris too.
choice:27:0:1.female: The Solitaries can defend Novaris too.

choice:25:0:1.text: Your presence alone could give away Tephesia's condition.
choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 那他们就能确定苔佩希的情况
choice:25:0:1.male: Your presence alone could give away Tephesia's condition.
choice:25:0:1.female: Your presence alone could give away Tephesia's condition.

choice:22:0:1.text: Why don't you come back to Novaris and handle this yourself?
choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 你为什么不回诺珐斯处理这些事？
choice:22:0:1.male: Why don't you come back to Novaris and handle this yourself?
choice:22:0:1.female: Why don't you come back to Novaris and handle this yourself?

choice:19:0:1.text: You're doing this to protect Novaris.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 用情报换取诺珐斯的安全，你不亏
choice:19:0:1.male: You're doing this to protect Novaris.
choice:19:0:1.female: You're doing this to protect Novaris.

choice:19:1:2.text: I have no more secrets to trade with you. Sorry.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 我现在没有情报给你，别指望了
choice:19:1:2.male: I have no more secrets to trade with you. Sorry.
choice:19:1:2.female: I have no more secrets to trade with you. Sorry.

say:11:1826023009:0.text: Understood. I'll tell him the roads are under repair and convince him to take a detour.
say:11:1826023009:0.source_cn: 是。我会以道路损毁严重，需要维修为理由，劝他绕道而行。

say:11:1826023009:0.female: Understood. I'll tell him the roads are under repair and convince him to take a detour.

say:12:1826023010:0.text: Understood. If he brings up any dealings between Novaris and Bantus, I'll say Her Ladyship hasn't been in the mood to work lately.
say:12:1826023010:0.source_cn: 是。班题斯的使者必定会问及与诺珐斯的各项合作，我会以领...
say:12:1826023010:0.male: Understood. If he brings up any dealings between Novaris and Bantus, I'll say Her Ladyship hasn't been in the mood to work lately.
say:12:1826023010:0.female: Understood. If he brings up any dealings between Novaris and Bantus, I'll say Her Ladyship hasn't been in the mood to work lately.

say:13:1826023011:0.text: If he insists, I'll escort him to the sites. The delays are real, so I won't even have to lie about them.
say:13:1826023011:0.source_cn: 若他坚持，我会带他前去检查。那些项目确实没有任何进展。
say:13:1826023011:0.male: If he insists, I'll escort him to the sites. The delays are real, so I won't even have to lie about them.
say:13:1826023011:0.female: If he insists, I'll escort him to the sites. The delays are real, so I won't even have to lie about them.

say:14:1826023012:0.text: Understood. I'll <style="highlight">report everything to you</style> once I return.
say:14:1826023012:0.male: Understood. I'll <style="highlight">report everything to you</style> once I return.
say:14:1826023012:0.female: Understood. I'll <style="highlight">report everything to you</style> once I return.

say:15:1826023013:0.text: Thank you for your guidance. I'll depart at once.
say:15:1826023013:0.source_cn: 感谢您的教诲。我即刻就出发。
say:15:1826023013:0.male: Thank you for your guidance. I'll depart at once.
say:15:1826023013:0.female: Thank you for your guidance. I'll depart at once.

say:17:1826023014:0.text: Magister Merlin, have you ever wondered what secrets this castle holds?
say:17:1826023014:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您是否好奇过，我们所处的这座城堡与庄园，究竟...
say:17:1826023014:0.male: Magister Merlin, have you ever wondered what secrets this castle holds?
say:17:1826023014:0.female: Magister Merlin, have you ever wondered what secrets this castle holds?

say:18:1826023015:0.text: Heh... Laying such precious intelligence bare does wound me a little.

say:18:1826023015:0.male: Heh... Laying such precious intelligence bare does wound me a little.
say:18:1826023015:0.female: Heh... Laying such precious intelligence bare does wound me a little.

say:21:1826023018:0.text: Then this debt must wait until Mother wakes to be settled.

say:21:1826023018:0.male: Then this debt must wait until Mother wakes to be settled.
say:21:1826023018:0.female: Then this debt must wait until Mother wakes to be settled.

say:5:1826023004:0.text: Yes, Master Eryndor. How long would you like me to keep him occupied?
say:5:1826023004:0.source_cn: 是，埃德加少爷。我需要拖延他多久？
say:5:1826023004:0.male: Yes, Master Eryndor. How long would you like me to keep him occupied?
say:5:1826023004:0.female: Yes, Master Eryndor. How long would you like me to keep him occupied?

say:6:1826023005:0.text: As long as you can without making him suspicious.
say:6:1826023005:0.source_cn: 在避免他察觉到异常的前提下，越久越好。
say:6:1826023005:0.male: As long as you can without making him suspicious.
say:6:1826023005:0.female: As long as you can without making him suspicious.

say:7:1826023006:0.text: You trained with the Solitaries. You'll know where the line lies.

say:7:1826023006:0.male: You trained with the Solitaries. You'll know where the line lies.
say:7:1826023006:0.female: You trained with the Solitaries. You'll know where the line lies.

say:8:1826023007:0.text: Leave it to me, Master Eryndor.
say:8:1826023007:0.male: Leave it to me, Master Eryndor.
say:8:1826023007:0.female: Leave it to me, Master Eryndor.
